detail: hary-frontend depends on hary-bff; hary-bff depends on hary-ai; hary-ai depends on the shared llm-gateway in front of model-provider.
hary-ai worker up. Assistant graph compiled: 11 nodes wired, 6 tools in the registry. Agent loop max_attempts=3, per-attempt timeout 20 s, partial-answer salvage enabled.

Config change applied: agent prompt pack v41 -> v42 (tool-calling instruction block reworded, function-call output contract restated inline). Rollout 100% of hary-ai workers, no code change in this bundle.
POST /v1/chat/completions returned 200 in 1798 ms (4180 prompt tokens, 271 completion tokens). Transport and gateway route healthy; response body carries a function_call block.

Agent attempt 1/3 aborted after 1798 ms: function-call payload failed schema validation (name='lookup_account', arguments 612 chars, decode failed at char 40). Classified retryable by _is_retryable_llm_error; backing off 400 ms and re-issuing the identical request.

Agent attempt 2/3 aborted after 2143 ms on a byte-identical function-call payload (same char-40 decode failure, same 612-char arguments). Retry budget 1 of 3 remaining; cumulative in-node latency 3941 ms against a 5000 ms soft budget.

Retry budget exhausted in the agent tool-calling loop: 3/3 attempts rejected the same function-call payload (attempt latencies 1798 ms / 2143 ms / 2612 ms, 6741 ms in node; 12540 prompt tokens and 2436 completion tokens billed for zero usable tool calls). _is_retryable_llm_error classified ToolCallParseError as retryable, so all three attempts re-sent byte-identical requests. Salvaging through _partial_answer_result; _flatten_for_salvage could not decode the buffered arguments either, so tool results are dropped and the reply goes back as a text-only prefix ending in '...[truncated: tool output unavailable]'. Status returned to hary-bff is 200.

Assistant answers are coming back 200 but short: p95 hary-ai call time 6.9 s against a 3 s objective, and answer_completeness has fallen from 0.94 to 0.58 in ten minutes. Nothing 5xx to alert on and the error budget is untouched, so no page fired.

Assistant panel: 14 sessions in the last 5 minutes reported the reply 'stopped mid-sentence'. Panel p95 render-to-answer is 7.1 s, up from 2.4 s, and every one of those requests returned HTTP 200. No error card was ever shown; the only user-visible symptom is a shorter answer.

Salvage path has handled 214 answers in 6 minutes and the shape of the bad payload has not varied once. From inside hary.graph.nodes.agent a model-side output regression and a defect in the v42 tool-calling template are indistinguishable: the request bytes we send validate against the tool schema and the transport keeps returning 200. Settling it needs the llm-gateway request/response log, which this service cannot read.
